summary: Session C1 (Finance & Sales) — comprehensive API + UI testing. 30/30 backend tests pass (23 new API-level tests via HTTP + 7 pre-existing unit tests). All frontend flows verified: Finance module (create invoice with correct totals €2.000/€420/€2.420, PDF, mark-paid, settings persistence after reload) and Sales module (kanban with 5 stages, lead CRUD, stage history via API, leads table, HR regression OK).

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 200 with {email_sent:false, email_id:null} when Resend rejects the recipient (e.g. any @example.com domain in Resend test mode). Not a bug per se — endpoint is fault-tolerant — but tests must use a Resend-accepted domain such as 'delivered@resend.dev' to get a real email_id. Consider surfacing the failure reason back to the client (currently swallowed).

issues: Line-item tax_rate input has no data-testid (finance-editor-item-tax-{idx}). Description/qty/price inputs are testable but tax field lacks it — minor testability gap.

Settings field testids are `finance-settings-prefix`, `finance-settings-terms`, `finance-settings-bank` — the review request specified `finance-settings-invoice-prefix`, `finance-settings-payment-terms`, `finance-settings-bank-details`. Mismatch is cosmetic (all controls work and persist after reload) but worth aligning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="finance-editor-item-tax-{idx}" on the tax_rate input inside the invoice editor for Playwright coverage.

OPTIONAL: Rename settings inputs to `finance-settings-invoice-prefix`, `finance-settings-payment-terms`, `finance-settings-bank-details` to match the review spec — current shorter names work but diverge from documentation.
OPTIONAL: In send_invoice_email endpoint, when Resend fails validation return the actual error message (or 4xx) instead of silently returning {email_sent:false}.
critical_code_review_comments: finance_module.py at 610 lines is nearing the 700-line split threshold — PDF rendering could be moved to its own helper module in a future refactor.
send-email endpoint swallows Resend exceptions silently (email_id=null) — should propagate at least a descriptive error to the UI so users know why the email did not go out.

Auto-mark-overdue in list_invoices() only mutates the returned list, not the DB record — status will 'flip back' on individual GET of the invoice. Consider persisting the status change or documenting the transient behaviour.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend HTTP tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_session_c1_api_20260215.py — run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_session_c1_api_20260215.py -v`. Use `delivered@resend.dev` as client_email whenever the send-email endpoint is exercised (Resend rejects @example.com in test mode). Kanban column testids ARE present in source (SalesModule.jsx line 179) — if a Playwright script does not find them, they are probably not yet mounted; add a short wait after navigating to /dashboard/sales. rca of the issue: No functional issues — a single failure on test_send_email surfaced during the first pytest run because the test used `acme@example.com` and Resend (LIVE key mode) refused to deliver to `example.com` domains. Fixed by updating the fixture email to `delivered@resend.dev` (Resend's official test address). Second run: 30/30 pass.
